newsitem.title: USA: Walbro says files for preferred offering.
newsitem.headline: Walbro says files for preferred offering.

text.p: Walbro Corp said it filed a registration statement with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission for a proposed public offering by Walbro Capital Trust of two million shares of convertible trust preferred securities.
Walbro Capital Trust was formed by Walbro solely to issue the preferred securities, which are convertible under certain circumstances into Walbro common stock.

Proceeds from the offering will be invested by Walbro Capital Trust in convertible debentures of Walbro, which will use proceeds from the sale of the debentures for repayment of a portion of its credit facility, it said.
Walbro makes fuel systems and other products for the automotive and small engine markets.
